definitions.explanation: Refers to the speaker or the subject of the sentence.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}でやってみてください。
{自分|じぶん}の{部屋|へや}を{掃除|そうじ}した。
{自分|じぶん}のことは{自分|じぶん}でする。
examples.english: I do my own things myself.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{意見|いけん}を{言|い}ってください。
{自分|じぶん}でお{弁当|べんとう}を{作|つく}って{学校|がっこう}に{持|も}っていった。
examples.english: I made a boxed lunch myself and took it to school.

notes:
{自分|じぶん} is a reflexive pronoun meaning oneself.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自分|じぶん}で (by oneself)
- {自分|じぶん}の (one's own)
- {自分|じぶん}{自身|じしん} (oneself - emphasis)

USAGE:
- Can refer to any person depending on context
- Often used where English would use "my/your/his/her own"
